headline: MIN @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 4.72 at BOS 3.61, with a projected total of 8.33. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIN moved +0.14 runs while BOS moved -1.18, changing the projected margin by +1.32 runs. The projected total fell -1.03, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jovani Morán has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Byron Buxton, Wilyer Abreu, Willson Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Caleb Durbin because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
